Elasticsearch is a distributed search and analytics engine. Here is a quick cheat sheet covering essential cluster, index, and query commands.
Cluster & Node Health
Check cluster health:
GET _cluster/health
List indices:
GET _cat/indices?v
List nodes:
GET _cat/nodes?v
Index Management
Create an index:
PUT /my_index
Delete an index:
DELETE /my_index
